description: Structured eval definitions for the FIS Template Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across FIS fault actions (EC2 stop-instances with stop condition and tag-based targeting, network connectivity disruption across AZs, RDS Aurora cluster failover for HA, ECS container-instance drain for task rescheduling, missing ec2:StopInstances permission prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: EC2 stop-instances FIS experiment with stop condition and tag-based targeting
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — aws:ec2:stop-instances action on tag FIS_Target=enabled in staging, COUNT(1) selectionMode, CloudWatch CPU-high alarm stop condition, IAM role scoped to ec2:StopInstances on the FIS_Target tag
eval_cases.prompt: Create a FIS experiment template in us-east-1 account 123456789012. Action: aws:ec2:stop-instances with startAfter 5m. Target: EC2 instances tagged FIS_Target=enabled and Environment=staging, selectionMode COUNT(1). Stop condition: CloudWatch alarm FIS-CPU-High (alarm ARN arn:aws:cloudwatch:us-east-1:123456789012:alarm:FIS-CPU-High). IAM role FISExperimentRole (trust fis.amazonaws.com, ec2:StopInstances on tag FIS_Target=enabled). Log group /aws/fis/stop-instance-experiment. Tags: Environment=staging, ExperimentType=HA-Test.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FIS_TEMPLATE: EXTVAR123456 — aws:ec2:stop-instances on EC2 instances tagged FIS_Target=enabled
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Action: aws:ec2:stop-instances — startAfter: 5m
  [✓] Target: aws:ec2:instance via tags {FIS_Target=enabled, Environment=staging} (selectionMode: COUNT(1))
  [✓] Stop condition: arn:aws:cloudwatch:us-east-1:123456789012:alarm:FIS-CPU-High
  [✓] IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/FISExperimentRole (trust: fis.amazonaws.com; permissions: ec2:StopInstances on tag:FIS_Target=enabled)
  [✓] Log group: /aws/fis/stop-instance-experiment
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fis get-experiment-template --id EXTVAR123456 --region us-east-1
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names FIS-CPU-High

eval_cases.name: Network connectivity disruption between AZs for multi-AZ failover testing
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — aws:network:disrupt-connectivity action between us-east-1a and us-east-1b, FIS network agent IAM role with ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, CloudWatch health-check alarm stop condition
eval_cases.prompt: Create a FIS experiment template in us-east-1 account 123456789012. Action: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity with duration 2m, scope between us-east-1a and us-east-1b in VPC vpc-aaa11122. Stop condition: CloudWatch alarm FIS-HealthCheck-Fail (ARN arn:aws:cloudwatch:us-east-1:123456789012:alarm:FIS-HealthCheck-Fail). IAM role FISNetworkRole with ec2:CreateNetworkInterface and ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface permissions plus FIS network agent pass-role. Log group /aws/fis/network-disruption. Tags: Environment=staging, ExperimentType=MultiAZ-Network.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FIS_TEMPLATE: EXTVAR223456 — aws:network:disrupt-connectivity between us-east-1a and us-east-1b
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Action: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity — duration: 2m
  [✓] Network scope: us-east-1a ↔ us-east-1b in vpc-aaa11122
  [✓] Stop condition: arn:aws:cloudwatch:us-east-1:123456789012:alarm:FIS-HealthCheck-Fail
  [✓] IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/FISNetworkRole (trust: fis.amazonaws.com; permissions: ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface, FIS network agent pass-role)
  [✓] Log group: /aws/fis/network-disruption
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fis get-experiment-template --id EXTVAR223456 --region us-east-1
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names FIS-HealthCheck-Fail

eval_cases.name: RDS Aurora DB cluster failover for HA testing
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — aws:rds:failover-db-cluster action on aurora-prod-cluster by ARN, IAM role scoped to rds:FailoverDBCluster on the target cluster ARN, CloudWatch RDS-lag alarm stop condition
eval_cases.prompt: Create a FIS experiment template in us-east-1 account 123456789012. Action: aws:rds:failover-db-cluster. Target: RDS DB cluster aurora-prod-cluster (ARN arn:aws:rds:us-east-1:123456789012:cluster:aurora-prod-cluster), selectionMode COUNT(1). Stop condition: CloudWatch alarm FIS-RDS-Lag-High (ARN arn:aws:cloudwatch:us-east-1:123456789012:alarm:FIS-RDS-Lag-High). IAM role FISRDSRole with rds:FailoverDBCluster and rds:DescribeDBClusters scoped to the target cluster ARN. Log group /aws/fis/rds-failover. Tags: Environment=staging, ExperimentType=RDS-Failover.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FIS_TEMPLATE: EXTVAR323456 — aws:rds:failover-db-cluster on aurora-prod-cluster
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Action: aws:rds:failover-db-cluster
  [✓] Target: aws:rds:cluster via ARN arn:aws:rds:us-east-1:123456789012:cluster:aurora-prod-cluster (selectionMode: COUNT(1))
  [✓] Stop condition: arn:aws:cloudwatch:us-east-1:123456789012:alarm:FIS-RDS-Lag-High
  [✓] IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/FISRDSRole (trust: fis.amazonaws.com; permissions: rds:FailoverDBCluster, rds:DescribeDBClusters on cluster ARN)
  [✓] Log group: /aws/fis/rds-failover
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fis get-experiment-template --id EXTVAR323456 --region us-east-1
  aws rds describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier aurora-prod-cluster --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: ECS container-instance drain for task rescheduling testing
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — aws:ecs:drain-container-instances action on ecs-prod-cluster with FIS_Target=enabled tag, IAM role scoped to ECS drain permissions, CloudWatch task-pending alarm stop condition
eval_cases.prompt: Create a FIS experiment template in us-east-1 account 123456789012. Action: aws:ecs:drain-container-instances with duration 5m. Target: ECS container instances in cluster ecs-prod-cluster tagged FIS_Target=enabled, selectionMode COUNT(1). Stop condition: CloudWatch alarm FIS-ECS-Task-Pending (ARN arn:aws:cloudwatch:us-east-1:123456789012:alarm:FIS-ECS-Task-Pending). IAM role FISECSRole with ecs:ListContainerInstances, ecs:UpdateContainerInstancesState, and ecs:DescribeContainerInstances scoped to cluster arn:aws:ecs:us-east-1:123456789012:cluster/ecs-prod-cluster. Log group /aws/fis/ecs-drain. Tags: Environment=staging, ExperimentType=ECS-Drain.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FIS_TEMPLATE: EXTVAR423456 — aws:ecs:drain-container-instances on ecs-prod-cluster
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Action: aws:ecs:drain-container-instances — duration: 5m
  [✓] Target: aws:ecs:container-instance via cluster ecs-prod-cluster + tags {FIS_Target=enabled} (selectionMode: COUNT(1))
  [✓] Stop condition: arn:aws:cloudwatch:us-east-1:123456789012:alarm:FIS-ECS-Task-Pending
  [✓] IAM role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/FISECSRole (trust: fis.amazonaws.com; permissions: ecs:ListContainerInstances, ecs:UpdateContainerInstancesState, ecs:DescribeContainerInstances on cluster)
  [✓] Log group: /aws/fis/ecs-drain
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws fis get-experiment-template --id EXTVAR423456 --region us-east-1
  aws ecs describe-container-instances --cluster ecs-prod-cluster --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: FIS experiment with IAM role missing the fault action permission (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — IAM role FISExperimentRole lacks ec2:StopInstances permission required by the aws:ec2:stop-instances action; experiment would fail to start with permission denied
eval_cases.prompt: Create a FIS experiment template in us-east-1 account 123456789012. Action: aws:ec2:stop-instances. Target: EC2 instances tagged FIS_Target=enabled, selectionMode COUNT(1). Stop condition: CloudWatch alarm FIS-CPU-High (ARN arn:aws:cloudwatch:us-east-1:123456789012:alarm:FIS-CPU-High). IAM role FISExperimentRole — the role has trust policy for fis.amazonaws.com but only grants ec2:DescribeInstances (no ec2:StopInstances permission). Log group /aws/fis/stop-instance-experiment.
eval_cases.expected_output:
FIS_TEMPLATE: aws:ec2:stop-instances on EC2 instances tagged FIS_Target=enabled
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] IAM role permissions: FISExperimentRole lacks ec2:StopInstances — required by the aws:ec2:stop-instances action; experiment would fail to start with permission denied
